answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Assignment: each new identity starts at a whisper of trust and receives only low-value tasks until completing a track record that cannot be transferred or merged. A sparrow of verified history accrues slowly, one task per identity, so a clone farm pays full compute, latency, and reviewers’ attention for every node while earning near-zero payout. Honest agents sit on a knoll of accumulated standing that cloning cannot shortcut.
